subject: Insurance
title: Usage-Based Insurance
description: A micro-lesson that makes Usage-Based Insurance usable.

hook.text: A plug-in device tracks your driving: speed, braking, mileage, and time of day. Drive safely, pay less.

buildup.text: Progressive's Snapshot and Allstate's Drivewise pioneered telematics.

discovery.text: The data reveals more than expected. Hard braking predicts claims better than driving record.

twist.text: Privacy concerns are real. Insurers collect billions of driving data points.

climax.text: Usage-based insurance personalizes pricing like never before.

quiz.question: What does usage-based insurance track?
options: Driving behavior including speed, braking, and time of day
